title: EXAMPLE LAYOUT - A user who never chose a display sees List
custom_preconds:
Setup for claude session

Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (an Admin and a new user) · 1 desktop browser · an email inbox you can open · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders build named in the test run, browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (below that width the page only offers List)
  • [User-B]: a user who has never opened Work Orders, with a role that can view Work Orders (e.g. Service Advisor), at the location used for the test [Loc-1]
  • Nothing else is needed: the work orders already at the location are enough

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin user (on a QA build: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page).
  2. Note the location shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). This is [Loc-1].
  3. Click your initials at the top right > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member.
  4. First Name ZZAUTOTEST, Last Name C96910 Never Chose, an Email you can open, Role Service Advisor, any Department, Location [Loc-1] > Save & Close. This user is [User-B].
  5. Open the invitation email, follow its link and set a password. Do not open Work Orders as [User-B].
  6. Check the setup worked: Settings > Staff lists [User-B] with role Service Advisor at [Loc-1]. If [User-B] ever opened Work Orders, create another new user and use that one.
custom_steps:
1. Sign out, then sign in as [User-B].
  2. Click Work Orders in the top navigation.
  3. Refresh the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The page opens in List: the ordinary work order table, not grouped by technician and not shown as columns of cards.
  • In the display switcher the List option is the highlighted one.
  • After the refresh the page is still in List.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R2, Key Decisions, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R2: “List is the default display option for every user until they choose another.”
  • Key Decisions: “Default display option remains List. Existing users see no change until they choose otherwise.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
